name: Maltitols
aliases: E965, E965i, E965ii, maltitol, maltitol syrup, jarabe de maltitol, maltitoles
what_is: A low-calorie polyol sugar alcohol obtained by hydrogenation of D-maltose.
why_botia: Maltitol is the most widely used sugar substitute in sugar-free chocolate: it is almost as sweet as sugar and its technological properties are very similar, which is why it also appears in sweets and baked products. It is only partly digested and absorbed — the rest reaches the large intestine, where it ferments and can cause gas or a laxative effect when enough is eaten. JECFA did not see a need to set a limit.
can_1: Detect E965 and map it to sweetener and E-number layers.
can_2: Provide context on glycemic properties and potential digestive discomfort.
cannot_1: Measure the exact percentage of maltitol added.
cannot_2: Confirm if nickel catalyst residues exceed the 2 mg/kg limit.
